annotation.title_clean: Commission Directive 2001/92/EC of 30 October 2001 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 92/22/EEC on safety glazing and glazing materials on motor vehicles and their trailers and Council Directive 70/156/EEC relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.title_en: Commission Directive 2001/92/EC of 30 October 2001 adapting to technical progress Council Directive 92/22/EEC on safety glazing and glazing materials on motor vehicles and their trailers and Council Directive 70/156/EEC relating to the type-approval of motor vehicles and their trailers
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Communities L 291
annotation.summary_en: Commission Directive adapting EU type-approval rules for safety glazing on motor vehicles to technical progress, replacing technical requirements with UN/ECE Regulation No 43 and updating administrative type-approval procedures. It has no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States grant EC type-approval to safety glazing meeting Annex requirements
Technical requirements replaced by UN/ECE Regulation No 43
Authorities must inform each other of type-approvals granted, refused or withdrawn
Transposition deadline 30 June 2002; new rules apply from 1 July 2002
Defines 'vehicle' as road motor vehicles with at least four wheels and over 25 km/h
